Chemist Hamilton Morris joins Joe Rogan for episode 1615 of the Joe Rogan Experience. Morris is known for his TV work on drugs of all kinds and for a lab mind in a wild field. Rogan is a famed fan of his work.

Morris and Rogan roam from plant drugs to lab-made ones and the laws that warp them all. Morris tells tales from his shoots in far lands and his tests in the lab. Rogan asks the questions his crowd most wants asked. Listeners get a smart, strange tour of the drug world. The library keeps the episode as a record of their talk.
